title: CRISPR-based multimodal genetic screens in human iPSC-derived neurons
overall_design: The Quant-seq experiments were performed using iPSC-derived neurons at Day 14, Day 21 and Day 28 of differentiation with 2 replicates for each sample. The CROP-seq experiments were performed using iPSCs and Day 7 neurons infected by a library of sgRNAs. Two lanes of 10X platform were used for each CROP-seq sample.
